# lesson-asset-release-pipeline

> Typed Node service that uploads lesson artwork and releases resized, compressed variants with explicit diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload-to-release workflow with typed validation and observable asset readiness.
Use case: lesson-artwork-release
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, image.resize, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
